messages:
laura (People Ops): Heads-up on review handback logistics — managers need to submit manager writeups by 2026-04-10 EOD PT. Calibration sessions will run week of 2026-04-14. Please block a 30m slot here: https://calendly.com/redwood-reviews/30m 🗓️

matt (Eng Manager): Quick q — self-assessments still due 2026-04-01 23:59 PT, right? I want to sync with my ICs before review writeups.

laura (People Ops): Correct — self-assessments due 2026-04-01 23:59 PT. Managers should aim to start reviews the next day. If you need APAC-friendly buffers ping me directly or use the exception flow.

jen (Manager, SRE): Can you drop the manager writeup template? I searched Confluence and found an older v2.

laura (People Ops): Uploaded — use "Manager Writeup v3 (rubric-aligned)" on our drive. Quick checklist below:
```
- Complete rating rationale (3-4 lines)
- Add 2 explicit examples of impact
- Fill career growth + calibration bucket
- Confirm manager calibration note (1-2 bullets)
- Submit via form: https://rdw.in/reviews/submit
```

sam (Director, Product): Reminder for managers: calibrations are rubric-driven. Please don't lean only on recent tickets — summarize sustained impact. We'll circulate pre-reads 24h before each slot.

ops-bot: Calendar invite created: "Manager Orientation — Review Cycle" — 2026-03-25 10:00 PT. Attendees: laura (People Ops), matt (Eng Manager), jen (Manager, SRE), sam (Director, Product).

matt (Eng Manager): I'll run a manager-only walkthrough Tues 13:00 PT to go through examples and the form flow. Adding it to the invite. @laura can you include the calibration rubric in the invite notes?

laura (People Ops): Will do — adding rubric PDF + short FAQ. Also adding a one-slide summary of what counts as an "impact" example.

jen (Manager, SRE): RSVP'd :white_check_mark: Thanks for the checklist — the code block was super helpful.

matt (Eng Manager): One more ask — for teams with cross-functional projects, is it okay to include sync notes from partner managers in the rationale?

laura (People Ops): Yes, please include partner-manager corroboration when relevant. If you can't get it in time, include a note that you attempted outreach and the outcome.

laura (People Ops): Final note: managers, please ensure each review has at least one explicit example under "impact" and one under "growth". DM me for exceptions. Thanks! :pray:
